methodology.Fees: Fees paid by vault depositors: instant and queued exit fees, performance fees and management fees, read from the program's events. Interest earned by vault deposits is counted in the Jupiter Lend and Jupiter Offerbook adapters, so it is not repeated here.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of performance and management fees. The program's protocol fee rate is currently 0.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of performance and management fees. The program's protocol fee rate is currently 0.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Performance and management fees paid to vault curators in newly minted vault shares, plus exit fees, which went to curators until the 10 November 2026 program upgrade and have stayed in the vault for the remaining depositors since then.

Fees.Instant Exit Fees: Fee on instant redemptions, valued at the redemption's own share price.
Fees.Queued Exit Fees: Fee on settled queued redemptions, valued at the vault's share price in the same transaction.
Fees.Performance Fees: Fee on gains above the vault's high-water mark, in USD as reported by the feeAccrued event.
Fees.Management Fees: Annual fee on vault assets, accrued over time, in USD as reported by the feeAccrued event.

SupplySideRevenue.Instant Exit Fees To Curators: Instant exit fees paid to the vault's curator in newly minted vault shares, until the 10 November 2026 program upgrade.
SupplySideRevenue.Queued Exit Fees To Curators: Queued exit fees paid to the vault's curator in newly minted vault shares, until the 10 November 2026 program upgrade.
SupplySideRevenue.Instant Exit Fees To Depositors: Instant exit fees kept in the vault for its remaining depositors, since the 10 November 2026 program upgrade.
SupplySideRevenue.Queued Exit Fees To Depositors: Queued exit fees kept in the vault for its remaining depositors, since the 10 November 2026 program upgrade.
SupplySideRevenue.Performance Fees To Curators: Performance fees paid to the vault's curator.
SupplySideRevenue.Management Fees To Curators: Management fees paid to the vault's curator.
